1.text:

and called it the Pi'illo Kingdom.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,>But then, over a short span...<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,>The Pi'illo Kingdom suddenly
fell and was no more...<C:0003,0001,>
